plain_english_revision: The amendment expands remote participation rules for Alabama State University's Board of Trustees by adding explicit provisions for video/telephone meetings, including emergency protocols and public access requirements. It also clarifies the board’s regular meeting schedule (May/November) and modifies notice procedures for special meetings.
candidate_position_supported: To standardize remote governance mechanisms for university boards under the Alabama Open Meetings Act while ensuring public participation in virtual proceedings.
evidence_quotes: Participation by such these means shall constitute presence in person at a meeting for all purposes.
Notice of an emergency meeting shall be given at least 72 hours before the time... unless circumstances require sooner.
telephone or video conference ... shall also allow members of the public the opportunity to simultaneously listen to or observe such the meetings.
review_reason: All changes are explicitly text-based and do not rely on external context.
